Validate cancer registry data

Source: R/validate.R
validate_cases.Rd

These functions inspect cancer case, population, and complete registry objects without stopping at the first problem. They return a structured table in which each row describes one issue and, where possible, identifies the source row and variable.

Usage

validate_cases(x, type = c("incidence", "mortality"))

validate_population(x)

validate_canreg(x)

validate_fbswicd(x)

Arguments

x

A case data frame, population data frame, or object of class canreg, canregs, fbswicd, or fbswicds.

type

Type of case data passed to validate_cases(): "incidence" or "mortality".

Value

A tibble of class canreg_validation with columns registry, component, row, variable, severity, rule, and message. An empty result means that no issues were detected by the implemented rules.

Details

validate_cases() validates an incidence or mortality data frame. validate_population() validates a population data frame. validate_canreg() validates a canreg object or every registry in a canregs object. validate_fbswicd() validates a summary-level fbswicd object or every registry in a fbswicds object, including checks between its case-summary and population components.

See also

as_canreg(), as_fbswicd(), read_canreg()

Examples

data("canregs")
validation <- validate_canreg(canregs[[1]])
validation
